name: inferrail
description: Know what your AI work costs, without keeping what it said.
long_description: Local, payload-free AI cost visibility for agents. Query spend by model, route, or tags such as customer or work_id from local Inferrail receipts without storing prompt or response bodies. Runs the published `inferrail` package with `uvx`, so uv must be installed.

tools.name: get_spend
tools.description: Known cost, tokens, and request counts from local Inferrail receipts, grouped by provider, model, route, or a request tag, optionally within a time window.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Whether an Inferrail gateway answers GET /health, plus the most recent local receipt. Never runs inference.

receipts_path.title: Receipts file
receipts_path.description: Your Inferrail receipts file (JSONL or SQLite). The default matches Inferrail's own: ./inferrail-receipts.jsonl, relative to the directory the client starts the server in.
